# Al Shimaa Quran Academy

> Al Shimaa Quran Academy provides online Quran classes for kids and adults worldwide, including Quran reading, Quran memorization (Hifz), Tajweed, Arabic language, and Islamic Studies. Students can book a free trial class and learn with qualified online Quran teachers.

## Main Services

- Quran Reading: Online Quran reading classes for beginners and advanced students.
- Quran Memorization (Hifz): Structured online Quran memorization programs.
- Tajweed: Learn correct Quran pronunciation and Tajweed rules.
- Arabic Language: Online Arabic language classes for Quran learners and students.
- Islamic Studies: Online Islamic Studies lessons for children and adults.
- Free Trial Class: Book a free trial Quran class online.

- [Teachers](https://alshimaaquranacademy.com/teachers.html): Information about the academy's online Quran teachers.
- [Pricing](https://alshimaaquranacademy.com/pricing.html): Quran course pricing and available plans.

- [Videos](https://alshimaaquranacademy.com/videos.html): Educational Quran videos and learning resources.
